name: lw_18499
statement: (f g h : ℝ → ℝ):(∀ x y z : ℝ, f (h (g x) + y) + g (z + f y) = h y + g (y + f z) + x) ↔ ∃ c:ℝ, ∀ x:ℝ, f x = c * x ∧ ∃ d:ℝ, ∀ y:ℝ, g y = d * y ∧ ∃ e:ℝ, ∀ z:ℝ, h z = e * z ∧ c + d + e = 1
closed: ∀ (f g h : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ x y z : ℝ, f (h (g x) + y) + g (z + f y) = h y + g (y + f z) + x) ↔ ∃ c:ℝ, ∀ x:ℝ, f x = c * x ∧ ∃ d:ℝ, ∀ y:ℝ, g y = d * y ∧ ∃ e:ℝ, ∀ z:ℝ, h z = e * z ∧ c + d + e = 1
informal: Find all triples of functions $f,g,h:\\mathbb{R}\\rightarrow\\mathbb{R}$ such that $f(h(g(x))+y)+g(z+f(y))=h(y)+g(y+f(z))+x$ for all $x,y,z\\in\\mathbb{R}$ .
type: ∀ (f g h : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ (x y z : ℝ), f (h (g x) + y) + g (z + f y) = h y + g (y + f z) + x) ↔ ∃ c, ∀ (x : ℝ), f x = c * x ∧ ∃ d, ∀ (y : ℝ), g y = d * y ∧ ∃ e, ∀ (z : ℝ), h z = e * z ∧ c + d + e = 1
